Definition: from G2414; a Hierosolymite, i.e. inhabitant of Hierosolyma:--of Jerusalem.
BiblicalUsage: Hierosolymítēs means of Jerusalem. It turns up twice, in Mark and John.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: Hierosolymítēs means of Jerusalem, and I do not stretch it further.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
